scope: All sample metadata identity/capture/conditions from source-linked GEO series; no expression outcome rows

title: NMFH-1
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA from patient-derived sarcoma cell models was extracted using the Maxwell RSC simplyRNA Tissue kit (Promega AS1340). The extracted RNA was quantified with a Nanodrop (ThermoFisher Scientific) and the High Sensitivity RNA ScreenTape Assay for TapeStation systems (Agilent 5067).
RNA-sequencing libraries were prepared using the Illumina Stranded mRNA sample preparation protocol following the manufacturer’s instructions
data_processing: Dragen Illumina
Sequence reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence/low-quality sequence using Dragen RNA pipeline
Trimmed sequence reads were mapped to GRCh38 using Dragen RNA pipeline
Quantification was performed using Salmon in Dragen Illumina RNA pipeline
Salmon quantification files were processed to generate raw counts using tximport in R
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file include raw count values for each Sample
